name: handoff
description: Before the context window fills, writes a handoff note and hands it once to your next fresh chat in this repo

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: Offer a handoff once the context window is at least this full (50 to 99)

summarize.title: Summarize with Haiku
summarize.description: Add a short 'where we are / next step' summary to each note: one Haiku call per handoff. Off: the note is built from the session alone, no tokens
